name: line-shadow-text
title: Line Shadow Text
description: A text component with a moving line shadow.

props.name: text
props.description: The text to render. When omitted, the plain-text content of the default slot is used (Magic UI's `children`); the shadow copy needs a plain string.

props.name: shadowColor
props.description: Colour of the moving line shadow. Pass a theme variable such as `var(--foreground)` to follow light / dark mode.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Motion props such as `initial` and `animate` fall through to it.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Plain text to render, used when the `text` prop is not set.
